verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents JWT access tokens whose grants scope each credential to one identity and room, with per-permission flags (roomCreate, roomAdmin, canPublish, canPublishData), subscribe-only tokens, and expiration. This is the product's own least-privilege credential mechanism. The evidence does not show these tokens issued specifically for agents, and it does not show scoping or restricting the server API key/secret pairs themselves, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: evidence of issuing scoped credentials specifically to agents, scoping or rotation of the API key/secret pairs themselves, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: This token encodes the identity of a participant, name of the room, capabilities (for example, publishing audio, video, or data), and permissions (for example, permission to moderate a room).
Access tokens also carry an expiration time, after which the server rejects connections with that token.
